'''Adno''' was a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] manufacturing company active around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It eventually merged with [[Ikas]] to form [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]].
